title: ⚡ Bolt: Cache hostOf parsed URLs in background
body:
💡 **What:** Added a `Map`-based LRU-like cache directly to the `hostOf` function in `extension/background.js` to cache host resolution.
🎯 **Why:** `new URL().host` allocations inside array filters (like `visibleInContext` during mapping loops or `buildMockIndexFor` logic) caused severe performance bottlenecks because native URL parsing is computationally expensive. It created redundant O(N) object allocations on every UI refresh or sync.
📊 **Impact:** Drastically speeds up array filtering operations in the background script. Prevents repeated URL instantiations inside tight loops, cutting O(N) operations down to O(1) cache lookups.
🔬 **Measurement:** Verify by loading a large list of interactions and observing CPU/memory usage drop during fast tab switches or UI updates. The cache is limited to 1000 entries to prevent memory leaks.
head: bolt-hostof-cache
